update_cc_test_checks: update LLVM IR CHECK lines in C/C++ FileCheck test files using clang and c-index-test
run_cc_test_checks: run update_cc_test_checks.py with --llvm-bin and test file paths to regenerate CHECK assertions
filter_function_checks: filter CHECK line updates to specific functions using --functions regex patterns
build_function_body_dictionary: build a dictionary of function bodies from LLVM IR output for CHECK line generation
get_line2spell_and_mangled: get a mapping from source line numbers to function spelling and mangled names via c-index-test
